etsy.title: CSS Poster, z-index 99999 Stacking Joke Print, Frontend Web Developer Gift, Nerdy Coding Wall Art
etsy.description:
A funny CSS poster for every z-index war ever fought, settled with z-index: 99999.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: CSS posters on Etsy are mostly HTML and CSS cheat sheets (one physical matte print at $24.99) and 'CSS to my HTML' romantic puns.
Code-snippet jokes like '.wife { right: 100% }' show buyers respond to CSS rules used as punchlines.
Web developer gift posters pair a short code piece with a witty caption.
CSS humor on Amazon is T-shirts ('I hate CSS', 'World's Best CSS Developer'); no CSS wall art seen.
'Web developer' and 'frontend engineer' are Amazon's audience words.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. 'css poster' is an Etsy market phrase and z-index is CSS. No priceRange: only one comparable physical price ($24.99) seen.
